records.why: Focus moves by programme not by pixel, jump-to-now shortcut and a now line that updates every minute are the fix.
Brand/identity restatement of a guide the app already is; carries nothing actionable for the scroll-jump defect.
Current location marked and back restores state is the 'you lose where you were' half of the sentence, missing in c3.
Keep focus on screen (scroll into view) is the exact invariant the half-hour snap violated.
On-platform but the guide's type scale is not what the task is about.
Overscan margins are unrelated to time-header scrolling.
